Medical Innovations - First Prize at Quantum 2015
Wednesday, 11 March 2015
7350 Hits
Shiv Joshi, Rajlaxmi Menghal, Manish Kashyap and Poshika Agrawal from 2011 batch bagged first prize at a National UG PG Convention – ‘Quantum 2015’ held at Datta Meghe Institute of Medical Sciences, Sawangi on 22
nd
February 2015.
The theme for the event was ‘Medical Innovations’ under which the team presented a scientific model titled – ‘Hope To Cure Paraplegia’ which showed Epidural Spinal Stimulation as the medical innovation.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
